rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial spoken term for a police officer.

example.english: The policeman is checking cars up ahead, so drive slower.
example.traditional: 差人喺前面查緊車，慢啲揸。
example.jyutping: caai1 jan4 hai2 cin4 min6 caa4 gan2 ce1 maan6 di1 zaa1

rows.note: Use this neutral term when referring generally to a police officer, including a female officer.

example.english: The policeman said the road was closed and told us to take a detour.
example.traditional: 警察話條路封咗，叫我哋兜路。
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 waa6 tiu4 lou6 fung1 zo2 giu3 ngo5 dei6 dau1 lou6

rows.note: Use this colloquial, sometimes mildly derogatory term specifically for a male police officer.

example.english: That policeman is always ticketing people here.
example.traditional: 嗰個差佬成日喺度抄牌。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 caai1 lou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 caau1 paai4
